fields.Name: IT139 - Query Refresh and Re-bind
fields.Description: Drives QueryExtractionService and RebindQueriesForChangedEntities against fixture queries over a fixture table (mjit_rebind, created by the bundle, altered inside the checks, dropped by Teardown) and the core view vwCompanies. QR1 refreshing queries whose facts match is Unchanged and writes no child row. QR2 a bulk refresh refreshes a composed query before the queries composing it. QR3 a re-bind refreshes exactly the queries that read the changed entity. QR4 a definer's-rights query (Query Permissions rows) that gains a column whose source field has field permissions is recorded as a Warning naming it (an all-Allow field rule is added for the check, field-level security stays off, and the rule is removed afterwards). QR5 a caller without the refresh grants gets the not-found refusal for an existing query, word for word identical to a missing one's, dry run included, and NotPermitted in bulk. QR6 a dry run reports an added column and writes nothing (row snapshots with timestamps compared). QR7 the added column reaches the SELECT * query and no other. QR8 a type change updates the field type. QR9 dropping an unused column leaves a query naming other columns unchanged. QR10 dropping a used column records Error with the server's message and keeps the SQL and the stored fields. QR11 renaming a used column does the same. QR12 queries whose stored dependencies form a cycle are each refreshed once and the cycle is reported once. QR13 dropping the view a query reads records Error with the server's message and keeps the SQL and the stored fields. QR14 a column going NOT NULL with a type change updates IsNullable and SQLFullType and the report names both; a stored NULL nullability is then corrected to false and reported (SQL Server; PostgreSQL's describe reports no nullability, so there only the type change is asserted). QR15 deleting the MJ: Entity Fields row a query field's SourceEntityFieldID points at nulls it (FK_QueryField_SourceEntityField is ON DELETE SET NULL, read from the catalog and seen to act) and a re-bind of the entity links the field again; a disposable probe field on MJ: Companies stands in for the dropped column and is removed in a finally and by Teardown, and the drop is driven as fixture SQL because a CodeGen column drop fails on the (EntityID, Sequence) unique index (UQ_EntityField_EntityID_Sequence). QR16 a caller who may read but not update MJ: Queries (the UI role) is refused exactly like one with no grant: the single refusal, dry run included, reads like a missing query's, and a bulk run reports the query NotPermitted and a missing ID Unavailable; nothing is written. Self-cleaning.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: A refresh re-establishes a saved query's facts from the live schema without editing its SQL, writes nothing on a dry run, follows dependency order, and refuses unauthorized callers without disclosing what exists.
